# noderings_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key that virtual machines can be created with. Keys cannot be changed in place; changing any argument replaces the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "noderings_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization (case-insensitive).
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key, for example the contents of `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint as reported by NodeRings.
- `id` (String) Key ID.
- `key_type` (String) Key algorithm: `ed25519`, `rsa`, `ecdsa` or `dsa`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an SSH key by its ID.
terraform import noderings_ssh_key.laptop 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
